results.description:
What does it take to build and scale a fintech business in Turkey?

Join Startup Grind Istanbul for a panel conversation featuring speakers from Ammen, KARTY, PayLink, PayLater and VoPay, exploring the opportunities, challenges and lessons behind growing a fintech business.

From earning customer trust to building partnerships and turning innovation into sustainable growth, hear perspectives that can help founders think bigger and move their businesses forward.

Connect with fellow founders, industry professionals and the startup community for an evening of insights and networking.

📅 21 October 2026
🕕 6:30 PM
📍 Nestwork M7

Be part of the conversation shaping the future of fintech in Turkey.
results.description_short: Join Startup Grind Istanbul for a fintech panel on October 21 at 6 PM at Nestwork M7. Gain insights from ammen, KARTY, PayLink, PayLater, and VoPay on scaling businesses in Turkey. Learn about earning trust, building partnerships, and driving sustainable growth. Network with founders and industry pros to help elevate your startup. Don't miss this chance to engage with the future of fintech.
results.title: Built to Scale — Powered by PayLink
